established: Save stores its pointer record before target load. A count1 target at its own pointer slot changes first8 target bytes before snapshot; immediate Restore cannot recover entry bytes under the stated valid/no-counter-overlap state.
limits: No ordinary caller or live initialization/ownership claim; conditional count1 only, no whole alias partition or universal malformed safety. Load-time snapshot remains exact, entry-time blanket postcondition needs a noninterference precondition or precise timing.
consumer: OPUS/SWE2-CONTRACT transform Save/Restore contract; FABLE workbench page
cleanup: Retained original evidence read-only, private artifact writes only; PC OFF, game/reference/save/config untouched
